title: Write a prescription from the appointment
summary: Create the patient's prescription: template, diagnosis, medications with dose and frequency, and print it.

steps.title: Menu → My Workspace
steps.details: The doctor's view: their schedule and the clinical panel of the patient they're seeing.

steps.title: Choose the patient's appointment
steps.details: Tap the appointment on the schedule: the patient panel opens on the right. If you don't see appointments, change the day or the period at the top.

steps.title: Template
steps.details: A prescription prepared in advance (Business Setup → Medical Instruction Templates) that fills in the medications.

steps.title: Add medication
steps.details: Each medication has presentation, dose, route, frequency, duration, quantity and instructions.

steps.title: Save the prescription
steps.details: Then you can print it with the print button.
